name: Agent Repo Workflow (clone + run agent against a prompt)
info:
Reusable clone/fetch + agent-run pipeline. Fully generic: it has no knowledge of issues/PRs/etc -- callers supply a `context` object and a prompt template, and any extra fields the caller puts on `context` are automatically available to the template.

Input msg must carry:
- `msg.context` ({host, owner, repo, model, ...anything else the caller's template needs}) -- only host/owner/repo/model are read by this subflow itself; everything else is opaque cargo for template rendering.
- `msg.promptTemplate` -- a string with `{{fieldName}}` placeholders resolved against `context` plus the post-clone `{{defaultBranch}}` and `{{repoSlug}}`.

Outputs:
1. Workflow log row (info/success/error) -- append to a log table.
2. Running-workflow count text.
3. Completion signal ({context}) -- fires only on full success.
4. Raw agent progress events (2nd output of the agent node) -- feed agent-log/derive-count/important-event taps.
